title: Blossoming Future

outfit_card.silhouette: A cropped diamond-quilted bustier top paired with a flared, multi-tiered skater skirt, sheer detachable sleeves, and a tulle underlayer creating a voluminous, youthful A-line silhouette.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A delicate silver butterfly hairpin with crystal wings, subtle pearl-tipped pins, and a translucent organza ribbon headband.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A sweetheart-neckline cropped corset in iridescent blue satin with diamond lattice smocking, pearl and crystal chain straps, and detached sheer organza sleeves with lace cuffs and metallic arm bands.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A high-waisted flared mini skirt with a glittering tulle overlay, ruffled white lace hem, layered petticoat, and a crystal rhinestone garter over sheer stockings with platform ankle boots.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Glowing crystal butterflies, floating holographic bubbles, and a sparkling musical-note motif that hovers around the wearer.
